title: Dashboard timeouts after deploy
summary: Engineers traced earlier dashboard timeouts to an un-indexed reporting query introduced in a deploy; rolling back restored render times.
resolution: Rolled back the deploy and added a covering index on the reporting table.

title: Duplicate charge retries
summary: Thread discussing gateway ack timeouts causing duplicate subscription charges and how refunds are approved.
resolution: Added idempotency keys to charge retries; refunds handled manually with approval.

title: Invalid credentials right after password reset
summary: Support flagged users locked out immediately after resetting their password; root-caused to cached session tokens.
resolution: Lowered session-cache TTL and added cache invalidation on password reset.

title: Webhook 401s after rotating secret
summary: Customer rotated their webhook signing secret and deliveries began failing with 401 until cached credentials expired.
resolution: Documented that secret rotation needs a cache invalidation; added a self-serve 'test webhook' button.
